description: This file manages SQLite database interactions for task flow registry, including schema setup, data serialization, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: normalizeNumber
methods.description: Converts number or bigint to number, or returns undefined if null.

methods.name: serializeJson
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON string or returns null if undefined.

methods.name: parseJsonValue
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a value of type T, returns undefined on failure.

methods.name: rowToSyncMode
methods.description: Determines sync mode from database row data.

methods.name: rowToFlowRecord
methods.description: Converts database row to TaskFlowRecord object.

methods.name: bindFlowRecord
methods.description: Converts TaskFlowRecord object to database row format.

methods.name: createStatements
methods.description: Creates prepared SQL statements for flow registry operations.

methods.name: hasFlowRunsColumn
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in the flow_runs table.

methods.name: ensureSchema
methods.description: Ensures the flow_runs table exists and has the correct schema, updating as necessary.

methods.name: ensureFlowRegistryPermissions
methods.description: Sets directory and file permissions for the flow registry database files.

methods.name: openFlowRegistryDatabase
methods.description: Opens or creates the flow registry database, applying schema and permissions.

methods.name: withWriteTransaction
methods.description: Executes a write operation within a database transaction.
